name: Dubuffet cells
description: Jigsaw-like cell drawings: a whole surface broken into interlocking puzzle-piece shapes with thick black outlines, filled with white, red and blue hatching, figures and objects hidden in the maze.
light: no light source, flat colour on white
white cells and black outlines on a black ground
muted earth tones: pink, grey and ochre cells on beige paper
bright red, blue and black hatching on pure white
composition: all-over, interlocking cells to every edge, no ground or horizon
one big figure or object built of cells, isolated on plain ground
a crowded street or room where people, cars and furniture merge into one maze
loose looping lines over a dark ground, cells half formed
camera_or_medium: marker, felt pen and vinyl paint on paper or panel; flat, confident black contour
texture_detail: thick black outlines, parallel stripe hatching in red and blue, flat white fills, slight hand wobble
subjects: a bicycle made of interlocking cells
a seated figure dissolving into a maze
a city street where cars and people share one outline
a coffee pot and cup as puzzle pieces
